title: Gradient Descent Golf
lede: Six holes on real loss surfaces, dealt fresh every day. Your clubs are optimisers: SGD, Momentum, Nesterov, RMSProp and Adam. Pick one, tune its learning rate, and the ball takes real gradient-descent steps across the terrain. Then watch four tuned rival optimisers race the same shot.
description: Gradient Descent Golf: a 3D browser game where optimisers are golf clubs. Six real loss surfaces a day, from Rosenbrock's banana valley to a gradient cliff.
